svg.aria-label: Research overview: how do we use AI to help people learn better? Four themes across 23 papers — how learners judge AI, modelling what students do, helping people write and learn, and putting it in front of teachers.

g.text: How do we use AI to help people learn better?
Paola Mejia-Domenzain · 23 papers · machine learning for education
Teachers act on what they are
CHI · LAK · AIED · EDM · ECTEL · L@S · IEEE TLT · BJET · JCAL · IJAIED
Model what students actually do — then make it legible enough to act on.
